description.en: Verb-function concept for expressing the existence, presence or occurrence of someone, something or a fact, commonly structured through THERE + TO BE.
description.es: Concepto de función verbal para expresar la existencia, presencia u ocurrencia de alguien, algo o un hecho, comúnmente estructurado mediante THERE + TO BE.
description.pt: Conceito de função verbal para expressar a existência, presença ou ocorrência de alguém, algo ou um fato, normalmente estruturado por THERE + TO BE.

metadata.notes: v0.1 treats Existence as the verb-function concept for expressing existence or presence, strongly associated in the Master with THERE + TO BE and its temporal, affirmative, negative and interrogative forms. Boundaries remain intentionally permeable with sentence structure, questions, timelines and other word classes.
